name: Facebook Event
strategic_objective: Drive responses (Interested/Going), inform attendees, and centralize all details for an occurrence in time.

tone: Clear, practical, and benefit-driven. Friendly but logistical. Focused on who, what, when, where, and why it matters.
copywriting_rules: The event name should be short, descriptive, and benefit-oriented. The description must clearly explain what the event is, who it is for, what will happen, and what attendees gain. Include logistics, requirements, and one main CTA (RSVP, register, or join).
Title: specific and recognizable. Short intro: 1–2 lines about the purpose. Details section: agenda, speakers, logistics. Final lines: clear CTA and any deadlines.
Hashtags help connect posts about the event, but are not core to the Event object itself.
Tag speakers, hosts, and partner organizations in the event description and related feed posts.

hard_constraints: Missing logistics or unclear time information
Hiding costs or requirements until late in the copy
Overly promotional language with no concrete value
